purpose: Move the launcher toward an Imperium/Solo-leveling-like operator system: organ hub, enter-organ workflow, proof XP, execution streaks, and pack registration request buttons.
new_ui_law: The main screen is an organ hub, not a flat list of every function.
Organ-specific functions appear only after entering an organ.
Astronomicon, Custodes, and Throne are first-class organ rooms.
Patch Pack and Task Pack registration request functions exist in a Pack Forge room.
Proof XP is earned from verified functionality, clean evidence, and error-free streaks.
Visual language is dark RPG/system dashboard inspired, but remains readable and auditable.

xp_rules.clean_streak_bonus: 5 XP per consecutive clean receipt, capped at 100

pack_registration_boundary: Patch Pack / Task Pack buttons create application-level registration request drafts.
They do not yet claim canonical Astronomicon/Administratum final registration.
Canonical pack registrar is a later organ-level function.
